id: title:Gilbert09:surface a clear error for unexpected token validation responses

review.posthog_relevance: Changes warehouse credential validation error messages for the Vercel connector, removing raw HTTP status codes and status-dependent phrasing from user-facing diagnostics.
review.reason: The observed hunks demonstrate a localized maintenance and user experience improvement: P1.F1.H1 adds a test to prevent status code leakage, and P1.F2.H1 replaces a status-dependent error message with a generic, user-friendly string. This is a bounded, substantive change to the warehouse connector's error handling, not a systemic architectural shift or unverified benefit. No score
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit depends on whether the previous status-dependent messages were confusing or harmful, which is not established by the code alone. The removal of status codes could also potentially reduce diagnostic utility if the status code was relevant to troubleshooting, though the replacement message suggests an intent to improve clarity. No adoption or incident avoidance is,

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a test asserting that an unexpected HTTP status code (404) does not appear in the credential error message.
